name: 光合作用
author: 原核生物 · 太古宙
core: 蓝藻等利用阳光把水与二氧化碳合成有机物并释放氧气，是地球生命能量与大气的根本转折。
coreEn: Cyanobacteria used sunlight to turn water and CO₂ into organic matter and oxygen — the foundational shift in Earth's energy and atmosphere.
influence: 为后续一切复杂生命供能，并制造了臭氧层与氧气，重塑了行星环境。
influenceEn: Powered all later complex life and built the oxygen and ozone that reshaped the planet.

name: 寒武纪大爆发
author: 动物界多门类
core: 在相对短暂的地质窗口里，绝大多数动物门类集中出现，硬壳、眼睛与捕食关系骤然繁盛。
coreEn: In a geologically brief window most animal body plans appeared at once, with shells, eyes and predator–prey relations proliferating.
influence: 奠定了之后五亿年动物演化的基本蓝图，今日的生物多样性由此展开。
influenceEn: Set the blueprint for half a billion years of animal evolution and today's biodiversity.

name: 植物登陆
author: 植物界（苔藓—维管）
core: 从水生藻类走向陆地，演化出输导、支撑与防止失水的结构，把裸岩变为土壤与绿色世界。
coreEn: Moving from water to land, plants evolved conduction, support and desiccation resistance, turning rock into soil and a green world.
influence: 为陆地动物提供食物与栖地，并深刻降低大气 CO₂、稳定气候。
influenceEn: Fed and sheltered land animals while drawing down CO₂ and stabilizing climate.

name: 四足动物登陆
author: 脊椎动物 · 肉鳍鱼
core: 肉鳍鱼演化出可支撑体重的四肢与肺，爬上陆地，开启了脊椎动物征服大陆的篇章。
coreEn: Lobe-finned fish evolved weight-bearing limbs and lungs, crawling ashore and opening the vertebrate conquest of land.
influence: 哺乳、爬行、鸟类与人类的共同起点，直接连通水中与陆上的生命史。
influenceEn: The shared origin of mammals, reptiles, birds and humans, linking aquatic and terrestrial life.

name: 恐龙辐射与中生代
author: 爬行动物 · 主龙类
core: 在中生代成为陆地霸主，体型与生态极其多样；其后裔鸟类延续至今。
coreEn: Dominant land vertebrates of the Mesozoic, wildly diverse in size and ecology; their bird descendants survive today.
influence: 塑造了中生代生态，其灭绝为哺乳动物崛起让出生态位。
influenceEn: Shaped Mesozoic ecosystems; their extinction opened niches for mammals.

name: 哺乳动物崛起
author: 哺乳动物纲
core: 恐龙灭绝后，哺乳动物迅速分化，填补空缺生态位，最终演化出智慧与人类。
coreEn: After the dinosaur extinction, mammals diversely radiated into empty niches, ultimately evolving intelligence and humans.
influence: 奠定了今日陆地脊椎动物的主体格局，也是人类的直系演化路径。
influenceEn: Set today's dominant land-vertebrate pattern and is humanity's direct lineage.

name: 被子植物大辐射
author: 被子植物门
core: 花与果实的高效繁殖策略，使被子植物在白垩纪后迅速成为陆地植物主力。
coreEn: Efficient flower-and-fruit reproduction let angiosperms become the dominant land plants after the Cretaceous.
influence: 与昆虫共演化，支撑了绝大多数陆地食物链与人类农业文明。
influenceEn: Co-evolving with insects, it underpins most terrestrial food webs and agriculture.

name: 人类起源
author: 灵长目 · 人科
core: 人属在非洲起源，直立行走、用火与语言，最终以文化与技术重塑整个生物圈。
coreEn: The genus Homo arose in Africa; bipedalism, fire and language led to a species reshaping the biosphere with culture and technology.
influence: 唯一能反思自身演化的物种，也是当前第六次大灭绝的主要驱动力。
influenceEn: The only species that can reflect on its own evolution — and a main driver of the current extinction wave.
